findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: An attacker can provide a specially crafted value for N that leads to an invalid shared memory segment request, which could potentially be used for OS command injection or other malicious purposes.
findings.assumptions: The value of N is not validated or sanitized before being used in shmget. The system's shared memory implementation may be vulnerable to certain types of attacks if N is manipulated.
